When still just a boy, the general had many questions. 
Why did the Guo family shrine hold so many ancestors' broken armor? 
Why did his father and uncle always make him practice writing "Chang'an"? 
And why would his grandfather lose sleep over a single frontier report? 

Later, as he walked farther, he understood more. 
When he passed through White Head City, Howling Sand, and Peaceward Camp, 
When he used a bandage to tend a wounded civilian, then looked up— 
he saw the look in their eyes. 
In that moment, the general thought he finally understood.
